import { AnimatePresence, motion } from 'framer-motion'
import { MousePointer2 } from 'lucide-react'
import { useState } from 'react'

export default function App() {
  const [showDetails, setShowDetails] = useState(false)
  const [currentIndexTitle, setCurrentIndexTitle] = useState(0)

  return (
    <main className="relative flex min-h-screen w-full items-center justify-center px-4 py-10">
      <div className="relative">
        <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1">
          <h1 className="relative z-50 flex gap-2 text-6xl font-medium text-gray-400">
            <span className="block">We</span>
            <span
              className={`dancing-script -mt-0.5 block cursor-pointer text-6xl text-gray-950 transition-colors duration-300 ${showDetails ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-50'}`}
              onMouseEnter={() => setShowDetails(true)}
              onClick={() => setShowDetails(false)}
            >
              Develop
            </span>
          </h1>
          <div className="relative flex h-[76px] flex-col items-center justify-start overflow-hidden text-6xl font-medium">
            {TITLES.map((item, index) => (
              <h1
                key={index}
                className={` ${index === 0 ? 'text-gray-400' : 'text-gray-950'} py-2 transition-transform duration-300`}
                style={{
                  transform: `translateY(${currentIndexTitle * -76}px)`,
                }}
              >
                {item}
              </h1>
            ))}
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-[30%] bg-gradient-to-b from-white"></div>
            <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 h-[30%] bg-gradient-to-t from-white"></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showDetails && (
            <motion.div
              className="absolute inset-0"
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 40, scale: 0.8 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 40, scale: 0.8 }}
              onClick={() => {
                setShowDetails(false)
                setCurrentIndexTitle(0)
              }}
            >
              {/* Card 1: line */}
              <div
                className={`group absolute bottom-24 left-20 size-40 -rotate-6 cursor-pointer rounded-3xl border border-slate-50 bg-white p-4 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.15] ${currentIndexTitle === 1 && 'rotate-0 scale-[1.15]'} ${
                  currentIndexTitle !== 0 &&
                  currentIndexTitle !== 1 &&
                  'opacity-30'
                }`}
                onMouseEnter={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(1)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(0)}
              >
                <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                  <MousePointer2 className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-4 w-4 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:-translate-y-2 group-hover:rotate-12" />
                </div>
                <StatusIndicator />
                <CardContent
                  type="line"
                  currentIndex={currentIndexTitle === 1}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Card 2: line-dot */}
              <div
                className={`group absolute bottom-[264px] left-52 size-40 rotate-12 cursor-pointer rounded-3xl border border-slate-50 bg-white p-4 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.15] ${currentIndexTitle === 2 && 'rotate-0 scale-[1.15]'} ${
                  currentIndexTitle !== 0 &&
                  currentIndexTitle !== 2 &&
                  'opacity-30'
                }`}
                onMouseEnter={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(2)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(0)}
              >
                <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                  <MousePointer2 className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-4 w-4 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:-translate-y-2 group-hover:rotate-12" />
                </div>
                <StatusIndicator />
                <CardContent
                  type="line-dot"
                  currentIndex={currentIndexTitle === 2}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Card 3: dot */}
              <div
                className={`group absolute bottom-40 left-96 size-40 -rotate-[4deg] cursor-pointer rounded-3xl border border-slate-50 bg-white p-4 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.15] ${currentIndexTitle === 3 && 'rotate-0 scale-[1.15]'} ${
                  currentIndexTitle !== 0 &&
                  currentIndexTitle !== 3 &&
                  'opacity-30'
                }`}
                onMouseEnter={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(3)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(0)}
              >
                <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                  <MousePointer2 className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-4 w-4 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:-translate-y-2 group-hover:rotate-12" />
                </div>
                <StatusIndicator />
                <CardContent
                  type="dot"
                  currentIndex={currentIndexTitle === 3}
                />
              </div>

              {/* Card 4: gradient */}
              <div
                className={`group absolute bottom-80 right-32 size-40 -rotate-12 cursor-pointer rounded-3xl border border-slate-50 bg-white p-4 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-[1.15] ${currentIndexTitle === 4 && 'rotate-0 scale-[1.15]'} ${

                onMouseEnter={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(4)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(0)}
              >

                <CardContent
                  type="gradient"
                  currentIndex={currentIndexTitle === 4}
                />

              <div

                onMouseEnter={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(5)}
                onMouseLeave={() => setCurrentIndexTitle(0)}
              >
                <div className="relative h-full w-full">
                  <MousePointer2 className="absolute bottom-2 right-2 h-4 w-4 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:-translate-y-2 group-hover:rotate-12" />

                <StatusIndicator />
                <CardContent
                  type="circle"

const TITLES = [
  'solutions that scale.',
  'robust backend systems.',
  'high-performance APIs.',
  'secure cloud architectures.',
  'optimized algorithms.',
  'clean, maintainable code.',
]

const StatusIndicator = () => {
  return (
    <div className="absolute left-4 top-4 flex gap-1">
      <div className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-red-400 group-hover:animate-bounce" />
      <div className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-yellow-400 delay-100 group-hover:animate-bounce" />
      <div className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-green-400 delay-200 group-hover:animate-bounce" />
    </div>
  )
}

function CardContent({
  type,
  currentIndex,
}: {
  type: 'line' | 'line-dot' | 'dot' | 'gradient' | 'circle'
  currentIndex: boolean
}) {
  switch (type) {
    case 'line':
      return (
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
          <div
            className={`h-1 w-16 rounded-full bg-black transition-transform duration-300 ${
              currentIndex ? 'rotate-180 scale-110' : ''
            }`}
          />
        </div>
      )
    case 'line-dot':
      return (
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
          <div className="relative transition-all duration-700 group-hover:rotate-90">
            <div className="h-1 w-8 origin-right rounded-full bg-black" />
            <div className="absolute -right-1 -top-3 origin-bottom-right transition-all duration-700 group-hover:rotate-[360deg]">
              <div className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-black" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    case 'dot':
      return (
        <div
          className={`absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 h-2 w-2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-black transition-all duration-300 ${
            currentIndex ? 'scale-150 animate-ping' : ''
          }`}
        />
      )
    case 'gradient':
      return (
        <div
          className={`absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 flex -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-1 transition-all duration-300 ${
            currentIndex ? 'scale-110' : ''
          }`}
        >
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded bg-gray-200 transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-y-1" />
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded bg-gray-400 transition-transform delay-100 duration-300 group-hover:-translate-y-1" />
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded bg-black transition-transform delay-200 duration-300 group-hover:translate-y-1" />
        </div>
      )
    case 'circle':
      return (
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2">
          <div className="h-6 w-6 rounded-full bg-black transition-transform duration-700 ease-in-out hover:scale-50 group-hover:scale-[2]" />
        </div>
      )
  }
}
